operating_notes.text: SWARAJ Sethu, launched 14 September 2026, is a DevSecOps platform covering source control, CI/CD, Kubernetes operations, infrastructure as code, configuration management, observability, security and governance, aimed at the domestic market.
Q1FY27 consolidated other expenses were ₹52.5 Cr, up 46% QoQ from ₹35.87 Cr in Q4FY26 while revenue fell 20% QoQ.
ESDS shares were listed on BSE and NSE on 4 September 2026 at an issue price of ₹429 per share under the Direct Listing Route.
Q1FY27 revenue mix was IaaS 51%, Managed Services 31.31% and SaaS 17.55%; GPU revenue is classified under IaaS.
Domestic order book is about ₹3,000 Cr with a 3-year duration; international pipeline is more than 50,000 GPUs.
Employee strength is 993, with about 100 additions expected from the Sharon AI deal but headcount kept below 1,000.
Domestic order book: INR3,000 crores with 3-year duration
International order book: larger than domestic book
Managed Services revenue in FY26: INR76 Cr (up 157% YoY)
